set.body: Add neuroim2 conditionally under Suggests. Construct an effectagram volume domain from NeuroVol metadata and compile volume searchlights with neuroim2::searchlight_indices(mask, radius, nonzero = TRUE), mapping stable full-volume indices through ordered feature_ids. Do not import neuroim2 ROI iteration, extraction, parallel execution, or result machinery. Verify masks, boundaries, anisotropic spacing, center order, absent/old dependency behavior, and future-plan nonmutation.
set.title: Add a narrow neuroim2 volume and searchlight adapter
